title: Blog Code Block Specification
description: JSON specification for embedding code blocks in blog posts using the `{{ { ... } }}` syntax.

@type.description: Discriminator for the code block spec. Must be exactly "code-block".

path.description: Relative path to the source code file, resolved from the current blog directory (e.g. "example.dart").

alias.description: Optional display name shown in the filename tab above the code block. Defaults to the basename of `path`.

sourceUrl.description: Optional URL to open when clicking the filename tab (e.g. a GitHub or API docs link).

start.description: Optional starting line number to use for the left-hand line number gutter. If omitted, the gutter uses the first included line from `lines` (or 1 when including the full file).

lines.description: Optional list of line ranges from the source file to include in the code block. When multiple ranges are specified, they are concatenated with a visual separator line between them. If omitted, the entire file is included.

highlights.description: Optional list of highlight configurations. Each entry assigns a color to one or more line ranges, referenced by original file line numbers.

from.description: First line number in the range (1-based, inclusive).

to.description: Last line number in the range (1-based, inclusive). If omitted, the range consists of a single line (`from`).

color.description: Highlight color to apply to the specified line ranges. If omitted, the default green highlight is used.

lines.description: One or more line ranges to highlight with this color. Line numbers refer to the original source file, not the snippet's relative numbering.
